title: Transfer Contacts

description:
Switching phones? Transfer Contacts lets you move all your contacts from one device to another in seconds — whether you're going from Android to iPhone, iPhone to Android, or any combination. No cables, no cloud accounts, no hassle.

HOW IT WORKS

1. Open the app on your old phone and tap "Send Contacts"
2. Select which contacts to transfer — or send them all
3. A 6-digit PIN appears on screen
4. Open the app on your new phone and tap "Receive Contacts"
5. Enter the PIN — done! Your contacts are saved instantly

It's that simple. No sign-up, no email, no passwords.

WHY USERS LOVE TRANSFER CONTACTS

Works across platforms — Android to iPhone, iPhone to Android, or same platform transfers. No account required — just install, open, and transfer. Transfers all contact details — names, phone numbers, emails, addresses, birthdays, company info, and more. Smart duplicate detection — won't import contacts you already have. Lightning fast — transfer hundreds of contacts in seconds, not hours of manual typing. Secure PIN-based transfer — your contacts stay private with a 60-minute expiring PIN.

COMPLETE CONTACT DATA

Transfer Contacts preserves every detail:
- Names (first, middle, last, prefix, suffix)
- Multiple phone numbers per contact
- Multiple email addresses
- Physical addresses (street, city, state, zip, country)
- Birthdays
- Company, job title, department
- Website URLs
- Notes

Nothing gets lost in the transfer.

PERFECT FOR

New phone setup — move all contacts to your new device in one go. Switching from Android to iPhone (or vice versa) — cross-platform transfer made easy. Sharing contacts with family or coworkers — send specific contacts to anyone. Backing up contacts — send your contact list to another device as a safety net.

AVAILABLE IN 34 LANGUAGES

English, Spanish, French, German, Italian, Portuguese, Japanese, Korean, Chinese, Arabic, Hindi, Thai, Vietnamese, Indonesian, Russian, Turkish, Polish, Dutch, Swedish, Norwegian, Danish, Finnish, Czech, Greek, Hungarian, Romanian, Bulgarian, Croatian, Serbian, Slovenian, Lithuanian, Estonian, Ukrainian, and more.

Download Transfer Contacts now and move your contacts to your new phone in seconds.
